author: The Current
description:
Billy Bragg describes  his choice of artwork for the single, "City of Heroes"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter Billy Bragg talks to The Current's Zach McCormick about how he connected with his longtime Minneapolis friend Jim Walsh to secure the artwork for the new single, "City of Heroes." Bragg also describes what the image represents to him in a larger context. 

Find Zach's full interview with Billy Bragg posted at https://www.thecurrent.org/feature/2026/02/05/interview-billy-bragg-talks-about-city-of-heroes-and-shares-words-solidarity-minnesota
